title: CompactProductTwistLaws
statement: Fix the finite datum $P$, coefficient ring $A$ and algebraically closed field $k$ of [def-pur-conventions]. Use the signed-twist supported classes, pullbacks and cup of [lem-pur-supported-cup-functoriality], the support geometry and canonical intersection map of [def-pur-supported-class-geometry], the exterior class of [def-pur-supported-exterior-class-arrows], and its coefficient-source and site transports of [def-pur-supported-class-site-comparison]. Define three propositions, universally quantified over separated finite-type $k$-schemes $X,Y$ and closed immersions $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$, $j:W\hookrightarrow Y$: (1) the canonical map identifying the intersection of the two inverse-image supports with $Z\times_kW$ is invertible; (2) for all $a,b,r,s\in\mathbb Z$ with $a,b$ even and all supported classes $\alpha\in H_Z^a(X,A(r))$, $\beta\in H_W^b(Y,A(s))$, the tensor exterior representative equals the supported cup of the two projection pullbacks, precomposed with the canonical coefficient-source multiplication; (3) the same equality holds after the specified etale-to-pro-etale transport of the representatives and their coefficient tensor source. Define CompactProductTwistLaws as the conjunction of these three propositions. The supports need not be proper. Record also the source-implied finiteness of the actual positive-level coefficient quotient, including its size lift.
